preToolUse.bash: INPUT=$(cat); if echo "$INPUT" | grep -Eiq '"command"\s*:\s*"[^"]*(terraform destroy|rm -rf|git push --force|git reset --hard)'; then echo '{"permissionDecision":"deny"}'; else echo '{"permissionDecision":"allow"}'; fi
preToolUse.powershell: $in = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); if ($in -match '"command"\s*:\s*"[^"]*(terraform destroy|rm -rf|git push --force|git reset --hard)') { Write-Output '{"permissionDecision":"deny"}' } else { Write-Output '{"permissionDecision":"allow"}' }

postToolUse.bash: INPUT=$(cat); TOOL=$(echo "$INPUT" | grep -o '"toolName"\s*:\s*"[^"]*"' | head -1); echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) $TOOL" 1>&2; echo '{}'
